actions: Read primary Fail-Fast/Restart-Smart arXiv HTML and extracted calibrated false-positive stopping budget, train/validation/test split, same-policy restart and optional edit-overlay results.
Read primary Self-Improvement Can Self-Regress arXiv record and extracted within-campaign early stopping, between-campaign CARE transfer gating, GRPO comparison and scoped quantitative outcomes.
Created a source-bound Stop/Restart controller matrix, checkpointed sequence 72, and advanced role-local LATEST by CAS.

new_evidence.failfast_restartsmart: On 500 SWE-bench Verified instances split 350/50/100, a calibrated observable-prefix monitor saves 14.6%-20.4% tokens at 5% target false-positive rate. On Qwen3.6-27B, restarting the same policy with no old prompt history but an optional initially-disabled repository-diff overlay raises resolution 66.6% -> 71.8% at 25% target FPR, versus 66.8% for cold restart.
new_evidence.self_regress: Across 10 sequential 20-step post-training campaigns, control-loop placement is regime-dependent: CARE improves Qwen-2.5-3B end-of-chain pass@1 4.9% -> 9.5%; on Qwen-2.5-7B ES reaches 22.2% versus naive 11.8% and GRPO 20.7%, while GRPO+ES is mixed.

scope_guards: FailFast/RestartSmart is inference-time single-trajectory recovery, not persistent self-modification.
Self-Regress is weight-updating post-training, not harness or skill evolution.
Do not infer a universal controller ordering; results are regime-specific.
These papers motivate separate Stop/Restart/carryover controls but do not close the equal-budget Stop/Continue/Widen/Reopen persistent-agent frontier.

termination.cause: checkpoint after additional scoped controller evidence; frontier remains nonempty

exact_next_action: Search for a persistent self-improving agent that exposes at least three actions among Continue, Stop, Restart-clean, Restart-with-artifact, resume-ancestor, Widen and Reopen and compares them under equal proposal/evaluation budgets with a selection-unused outer test; separately audit false-positive stop harm, anytime-valid promotion, durable cross-proposal spending, immutable identity, feedback bandwidth, restart reconciliation and complete chronology.
